name: front-desk-ai-orchestrator
description: Front Desk AI Orchestrator: backend API + Vite dashboard + Chrome extension

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:dashboard
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf node_modules backend/node_modules dashboard/node_modules backend/dist dashboard/dist
